granular.description: Multi-agent coordination (shared message bus + persistent diaries). agent_type.description: Agent type for register (cursor, claude, codex, gemini, crush, subagent)

category.description: Message category for post (finding, warning, request, status)

message.description: Message text for post action, or status detail for status action

to_agent.description: Target agent ID for direct message (omit for broadcast)

granular.description: Benchmark compression modes for a file or project.

granular.description:
Invoke any of the 50+ lean-ctx tools by name. Use for tools not in the core set.
CATEGORIES:
arch: ctx_architecture, ctx_impact, ctx_callgraph, ctx_refactor, ctx_symbol, ctx_routes, ctx_smells, ctx_index
debug: ctx_benchmark, ctx_verify, ctx_analyze, ctx_profile, ctx_proof, ctx_review
memory: ctx_semantic_search, ctx_artifacts
batch: ctx_fill, ctx_execute, ctx_expand, ctx_pack, ctx_plan, ctx_control, ctx_compile
agent: ctx_agent, ctx_share, ctx_task, ctx_handoff, ctx_workflow
util: ctx_compress, ctx_cache, ctx_retrieve, ctx_metrics, ctx_radar, ctx_dedup, ctx_cost, ctx_gain, ctx_heatmap, ctx_feedback, ctx_ledger, ctx_preload
Example: ctx_call({"name":"ctx_architecture","arguments":{"action":"overview"}})

arguments.description: Arguments object to pass to the invoked tool

granular.description: Context checkpoint for long conversations.
granular.name: ctx_compress

granular.description: Session context overview — cached files, seen files, session state.
granular.name: ctx_context

granular.description: Universal context manipulation (Context Field Theory). Actions: exclude|include|pin|unpin|set_view|set_priority|mark_outdated|reset|list|history. Overlay-based, reversible, scoped.

value.description: New content, view name, or priority

granular.name: ctx_control

granular.description: Cost attribution (local-first). Actions: report|agent|tools|json|reset.
granular.name: ctx_cost

granular.description: Cross-file dedup: analyze or apply shared block references.

granular.description: Find missed compression opportunities in shell history.

old_string.description: Exact text to find and replace (must be unique unless replace_all=true)

granular.name: ctx_edit

granular.description: Run code in sandbox (11 languages). Only stdout enters context. Raw data never leaves subprocess. Languages: javascript, typescript, python, shell, ruby, go, rust, php, perl, r, elixir.

action.description: batch — execute multiple scripts. Provide items as JSON array [{language, code}]

intent.description: What you want from the output (triggers intent-driven filtering for large results)

granular.name: ctx_expand

granular.description: Harness feedback for LLM output tokens/latency (local-first). Actions: record|report|json|reset|status.

agent_id.description: Agent ID (optional; defaults to current agent)

granular.description: Budget-aware context fill — auto-selects compression per file within token limit.

granular.description: Gain report (includes Wrapped via action=wrapped).
granular.name: ctx_gain

granular.name: ctx_graph

granular.description: Context Ledger Protocol (hashed, deterministic, local-first). Actions: create|show|list|pull|clear|export|import.

apply_workflow.description: For pull/import: apply workflow state (default: true)

paths.description: Optional file paths for curated refs (for create/export)

granular.name: ctx_handoff

granular.description: File access heatmap — shows most frequently accessed files.

granular.description: Index orchestration. Actions: status|build|build-full.

granular.description: Structured intent input (optional) — submit compact JSON or short text; server also infers intents automatically from tool calls.

granular.description: Persistent project knowledge across sessions (facts, patterns, history). Supports recall modes, embeddings, feedback, and typed relations.

category.description: Fact category (architecture, api, testing, deployment, conventions, dependencies)

resolution.description: For gotcha action: how to fix/avoid it

severity.description: For gotcha action: severity level (default: warning)

trigger.description: For gotcha action: what triggers the bug

value.description: Value for action (fact value, pattern text, feedback up/down, relation kind).

granular.name: ctx_knowledge

granular.description: Session token stats, cache rates, per-tool savings.
granular.name: ctx_metrics

granular.description: Batch read files in one call. Same modes as ctx_read.

mode.description: Compression mode (default: full). Same modes as ctx_read (auto, full, map, signatures, diff, aggressive, entropy, task, reference, lines:N-M).

paths.description: Absolute file paths to read, in order

alias.description: Short alias for the repo (for add_root). Auto-derived from directory name if omitted.

roots.description: Filter search to specific roots by alias or path (for search). Omit to search all.

granular.name: ctx_multi_repo

granular.description: List all symbols in a file (functions, structs, classes, methods) with signatures. Much fewer tokens than reading the full file.
granular.name: ctx_outline

granular.description: Task-relevant project map — use at session start.
granular.name: ctx_overview

granular.description: Context Package Manager. Actions: pr (PR context), create (build package from project), list, info, remove, install, export, import, auto_load, summary.

apply.description: Apply package after import (for import action, default: false)

base.description: Git base ref (for pr action, default: auto-detect)

diff.description: Git diff --name-status text (for pr action; if omitted, computed via git)

enable.description: Enable or disable auto-load (for auto_load action, default: true)

format.description: Output format (for pr action, default: markdown)

layers.description: Layers to include: knowledge, graph, session, patterns, gotchas (for create)

name.description: Package name (required for create, info, remove, install, export, auto_load)

granular.name: ctx_plugins

changed_files.description: Optional changed files (paths) to compute blast radius

granular.name: ctx_prefetch

granular.name: ctx_preload

granular.description: Export a machine-readable ContextProofV1 (Verifier + SLO + Pipeline + Provenance). Writes to .lean-ctx/proofs/ by default.

max_ledger_files.description: Max context ledger top files to include (default: 10)

granular.name: ctx_proof

granular.description: External context providers (GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Postgres, custom). action=discover|list: list registered providers. action=status: provider health + cache metrics. action=refresh: invalidate cache + re-fetch (provider= optional). action=configure: show config (resource=paths|template for details). action=query: provider+resource for data access. Legacy GitLab actions still supported.

action.description: Provider action. 'discover'/'list' lists all. 'status' shows health+cache. 'refresh' invalidates+re-fetches. 'configure' shows config. 'query' uses registry routing.

mode.description: Output mode for action=query. 'compact' (default) or 'chunks' for BM25/embedding ingest.

provider.description: Provider ID (e.g. 'github', 'gitlab', 'jira', 'mcp:my-kb'). Required for query, optional for refresh (omit to refresh all).

resource.description: Resource type for action=query (e.g. 'issues', 'pull_requests'). For configure: 'paths'|'template'|'show'.

state.description: Filter by state (open, closed, merged, all)

granular.name: ctx_provider

granular.description: Full context budget breakdown: system prompt, messages, tools, reads, shell — all tracked token usage.
granular.name: ctx_radar

granular.description: Read file (cached, compressed). Cached re-reads can be ~13 tok when unchanged. Auto-selects optimal mode. Modes: full|map|signatures|diff|aggressive|entropy|task|reference|lines:N-M. fresh=true forces a disk re-read.

fresh.description: Bypass cache and force a full re-read. Use when running as a subagent that may not have the parent's context.

mode.description: Compression mode (default: auto — resolved per file type/size). Explicit 'full' for guaranteed complete content. Use 'map' for context-only files. For line ranges: 'lines:N-M' (e.g. 'lines:400-500').

start_line.description: Start reading from this line (only used when no explicit mode is set, or with mode=lines). Does NOT override explicit modes like map/signatures.

granular.name: ctx_read

granular.name: ctx_refactor

granular.description: PageRank-based repo map showing the most important symbols across the codebase, ranked by structural importance and session relevance.

focus_files.description: Files to boost in ranking (relative paths)

path.description: Project root path (default: session project root)

granular.name: ctx_rules

paths.description: Multiple directories to search (alternative to path)

path_glob.description: Optional: glob over relative file paths

query.description: Natural language or symbol search query

granular.name: ctx_semantic_search

granular.description: Cross-session memory (CCP). session_id.description: Session ID for load action (default: latest)

granular.name: ctx_session

to_agent.description: Target agent ID (omit for broadcast to all agents)

env.description: Additional environment variables to set for the command. Use to pass agent runtime vars (e.g. CODEX_THREAD_ID).

granular.name: ctx_task

paths.description: Multiple directories to list (alternative to path)

granular.name: ctx_tree

granular.description:
Fetch a web page, PDF, or YouTube URL as compressed, cited context.
HTML/PDF→clean text, YouTube→transcript; modes: auto|markdown|text|links|facts|quotes|transcript.
facts/quotes return claims with confidence + source. SSRF-guarded (http/https only, blocks private/loopback).
Use for research/crawl instead of raw fetch.

mode.description: Distillation mode (default: auto — Markdown for pages, transcript for videos)

query.description: Optional focus query; boosts relevance in facts/quotes modes

url.description: http(s) URL of a page or YouTube video
